title: Govt. accepts responsibility for students with disabilities: PM
byline: Building a respectful education system that treats everyone equally is a fundamental objective of the Government, while it has also accepted the responsibility of ensuring a better future for students with disabilities, Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya said.

title: UK government rejects ’kill switch’ idea for dangerous AI
byline: The UK government has rejected the idea of creating a so-called ’’kill switch’’ to stop a dangerous attack from rogue AI.

title: “NPP government attempting to capture the judiciary and 88/89 era will repeat again” - Archuna
byline: Opposition Parliamentarian from the Jaffna District, Archuna Ramanathan today warned that the country will once again face the dark era of 88/89 in 2029 as the NPP was attempting to capture the judiciary and parliament under its control.

title: “I see you from the iron bars of prison. You all are my strength”- Namal tells supporters
byline: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) MP Namal Rajapaksa, currently in remand custody, said the challenges he was facing would make him stronger rather than break him.

title: “Fathers should have advised their sons not to steal; what can I do if they are caught?” – President
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said claims of political revenge and attempts to gain public sympathy would not deter the Government from taking legal action against those accused of corruption and misappropriation of public funds.

title: No revenge, but wrongdoers will face justice:  President
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said there would be no compromise or leniency towards organised criminal networks and the illegal drug trade, stressing that the government was committed to eradicating the underworld and drug operations from the country.

title: Mahinda joins SLPP’s ‘Janasatana’ rally in Anuradhapura
byline: Anuradhapura, Sep 12 (DailyMirror); Former President Mahinda Rajapaksa joined the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna’s (SLPP) “Janasatana” public rally in Anuradhapura today (12), as the party stepped up its political activities against the government.

title: Fuel prices to remain unchanged for now: CPC
byline: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) has assured that there will be no immediate increase in domestic fuel prices despite a sharp rise in global crude oil prices.

title: SLPP’s ‘Janasatana’ rally underway in Anuradhapura
byline: Anuradhapura, Sep 12 (DailyMirror); The Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) “Janasatana” public rally is being held in Anuradhapura today, with several former Ministers and MPs attending the gathering. Former President Mahinda Rajapaksa is also expected to attend the rally.

title: South Asian University signs landmark MOU with the Regional Centre for Strategic Studies, Colombo
byline: In a landmark step towards strengthening regional cooperation, the South Asian University (SAU) has signed an MOU with the Regional Centre for Strategic Studies (RCSS), Colombo, Sri Lanka, to foster research networks, partnerships and collaborations for transformative change across South Asia, a joint statement from the two parties said.

title: No Mithuri, no alternatives: Women face contraceptive crisis
byline: Women who rely on a commonly used contraceptive pill are facing difficulties obtaining it, with Mithuri and alternative contraceptive brands reportedly difficult to find at pharmacies, raising concerns over access to family planning services.

title: El Nino prompts authorities to grow short-duration paddy varieties : Minister
byline: As it has been revealed that the El Niño phenomenon is expected to affect paddy cultivation during the end of 2026 and the first three months of 2027 to a high degree, the Ministry of Agriculture has drawn up a plan to grow short-duration paddy varieties to ensure food security, Parliament was informed yesterday.

title: China’s Xi lands in Delhi for BRICS summit and talks with Modi
byline: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in the Indian capital on Saturday for the ​summit of leaders of the BRICS group ‌of countries and talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Indian TV channels showed.

title: No power cuts expected in coming months, Minister assures
byline: Energy Minister Anura Karunathilaka yesterday assured Parliament that Sri Lanka will not face an electricity crisis in the coming months despite the possible impact of the El Niño phenomenon, as sufficient water is available in reservoirs and the Government is accelerating plans to introduce a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS).

title: PC polls - Opposition members of Select Committee looking into electoral system resign
byline: Opposition members of the select committee appointed to look into the drawing up of an electoral system for Provincial Councils announced their resignation in protest against the extension of the timeframe given to it until December 17, 2026.

title: Port employee, businessman remanded over alleged smart key racket
byline: A port employee and a businessman have been remanded over their alleged involvement in a racket involving the theft and sale of smart keys belonging to vehicles imported through the Hambantota International Port, police said.

title: Naval, fishing communities urged to remain vigilant amid rough seas
byline: Naval and fishing communities engaged in activities in the sea areas from Hambantota to Pottuvil have been urged to remain vigilant as rough sea conditions and strong winds are expected in the area.

title: Strongest El Niño in 75 years?
byline: Sri Lanka is facing the potential impact of an unusually strong El Niño, with the Department of Meteorology warning that the phenomenon could significantly disrupt normal weather patterns, bringing heavy rainfall later this year followed by a risk of water shortages early next year.

title: Magnitude 6.5 earthquake strikes near Jakarta
byline: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck near Jakarta’s Thousand Islands (Kepulauan Seribu) early Saturday, with tremors felt in the Indonesian capital and across parts of Java and Sumatra.

title: Ceylon Motor Traders’ Association urges action on Rs.40bn govt. revenue leakage
byline: The Ceylon Motor Traders’ Association (CMTA), established in 1919 and the most senior automotive association in Sri Lanka affiliated with the Ceylon Chamber of Commerce, is calling for greater consistency,

title: GS Evo Motors launches all-new JMEV EWIND
byline: GS Evo Motors Limited, the authorised distributor of JMEV electric vehicles in Sri Lanka, has announced the official launch of JMEV EWIND,

title: ’Never, ever forget’ - America marks 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
byline: Twenty-five years after 9/11, US presidents past and present have commemorated the lives lost when hijacked planes slammed into the World Trade Center, the Pentagon and a Pennsylvania field.

title: Modi, Putin seek stronger ties as Russia calls for BRICS to counter West
byline: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed on Friday to deepen ‌their countries’ longstanding ties, with Putin saying the BRICS grouping should build a new platform for global growth free from Western rules.

title: 13-year-old boy dies in fireworks explosion in Valachchenai
byline: A 13-year-old boy has died following a tragic fireworks explosion during an annual temple festival in the Valachchenai area of Batticaloa last night (11).

title: Grenades become weapon of fear: Available for as little as Rs. 10,000 – 20,000
byline: Hand grenades are increasingly being used by organised criminal groups to threaten rivals and settle disputes, raising concerns among security authorities over the availability of old military explosives and the danger they pose to the public.

title: Concessions announced for teachers’ efficiency bar examinations
byline: The Public Service Commission has approved several concessions for teachers serving in national and provincial schools following the introduction of a new efficiency bar examination system under the amended Teachers’ Service Minute.

title: Emergency help at your fingertips: Police introduce new SOS app
byline: Sri Lanka Police has introduced a new mobile application aimed at helping members of the public quickly notify police during emergencies.

title: Tea auction sees mixed price trends as offerings fall
byline: The overall auction offerings declined to 5.1 million kilogrammes (M/Kgs), from a 5.3 M/Kgs on offer the previous week.

title: Norway’s Princess Astrid dies two days after attending brother King Harald’s funeral
byline: Princess Astrid of Norway, the sister of the late King Harald V, has died at the age of 94, two days after attending his funeral, the country’s royal palace has announced.

title: Sri Lanka reach Women’s Asia Cup 2026 final
byline: Sri Lanka Women secured a dramatic four-wicket victory over Pakistan Women in the second semi-final of the Women’s Asia Cup 2026 at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium, booking their place in the final against India.
